messages:
maria: Hey — hitting a frustrating install/resolver issue with the Python sample-app quickstart. Followed README (poetry install -> poetry run pip install -e .) and pip fails with a resolver error for httpx. Anyone seen this?

sam: Can you paste the pyproject deps and the pip error?

maria: Sure — pyproject excerpt:```toml
[tool.poetry.dependencies]
python = "^3.10"
redwood-sdk = "^0.12.0"
requests = "^2.28"
# async example uses extras
httpx = {extras = [\"http2\"], version = "^0.23"}
```pip output:```
ERROR: Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement httpx==0.25.0 (from -r requirements.txt (line 4))
# resolver was trying to upgrade/downgrade conflicting transitive deps
```

devx-bot: FYI: reading onboarding issues tag. See onboarding guide: https://redwood.dev/docs/quickstart - please include full lockfile when filing.

lucas: That error usually means mixed dependency sources. If you run `poetry export -f requirements.txt --without-hashes -o /tmp/reqs.txt` then `pip install -r /tmp/reqs.txt` you should get the same resolver result as poetry. But watch out for system wheels (cryptography) on mac.

maria: Export+pip gave the same httpx complaint. Also CI fails building cryptography wheel (mac-latest runner).

anya: We hit this last week in onboarding. Two issues combined here: 1) sample-app was listing httpx as an extra in docs but not consistently in pyproject, and 2) editable installs (pip -e) + poetry lock sometimes produce mismatched resolver choices if you mix commands. Quick fixes that worked for us: add httpx to normal dependencies (not just extras) in pyproject, and ensure package_data includes the typing stubs so pip doesn't drop them. Example change I made in our fork:```toml
[tool.poetry.dependencies]
httpx = "^0.23.0"
[tool.poetry.package.include]
# include mypy stubs shipped alongside code
"**/*.pyi" = true
```

sam: Can you open a tiny PR against sample-app? Pinning httpx to 0.23 in the short term avoids the resolver flip. Also add a line in README: "Use `poetry run pip install -e .` or `poetry export` to avoid mixed resolvers."

maria: I pushed a quick PR that pins httpx and adds include for stubs. CI still failed on cryptography wheel on mac, but when I installed `libssl` via brew (`brew install openssl@1.1`) and set `LDFLAGS`/`CPPFLAGS` it built fine. I'll add a note for mac devs.

lucas: Filed DEVEX-312 to update quickstart + add a troubleshooting section for mac cryptography and for editable vs export installs.

anya: Long-term we should: 1) avoid shipping conflicting deps between sync and async examples, 2) publish a single reproducible requirements file for the quickstart, and 3) include a CI workflow that validates the quickstart install on linux/mac.

maria: Confirmed — local install works now after the pin + openssl note. Thanks! :tada: I'll close the loop in the PR description with steps to reproduce and the export output.

sam: Thanks — good catch. Leaving a follow-up checklist in the PR for DX to do a sweep on other sample repos. :+1:
